reader_summary.overview: Today's show is a panel about the merits of private equity. a former partner at Apollo and twenty-five-year veteran of the industry. On the other is Brendan Ballou. Our conversation begins with Sachin's view on private markets as an essential value-additive element of the economy and Brendan's thesis on the inadequacy of the legal structure surrounding the activity..
